name: new_sudoku_benchmark_1045
description: A dataset of Sudoku puzzles intended to benchmark algorithms' ability to solve Sudoku instances (complete grid reconstruction) across varying puzzle difficulties. Measures constraint reasoning, search and planning abilities of models/agents by requiring generation of full valid solutions from partial grids. Primarily used for algorithmic and reinforcement-learning evaluations of puzzle-solving performance.
reputation: A niche benchmark published by the MultiRL community for Sudoku/constraint-solving research with limited mainstream adoption.
